title: Venezuelan Bowl
description: A delicious and flavorful dish with a Venezuelan twist, served in a bowl with various ingredients.
instructions: Cook the rice according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the diced red onion and cook until translucent.
Add the diced tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cooked black beans, corn, cumin, and chili powder to the pan. Stir well.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced umeboshi and cook until slightly caramelized.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked rice in the bottom, followed by a spoonful of the bean and corn mixture.
Top with sliced umeboshi, diced avocado, and a dollop of sour cream (if using).
